description: Golden parity for compensation.getBenefitsUtilization: buildBenefitsUtilization(plans, totalUsers) in @tims/shared. Asserted IDENTICALLY by the REAL TS export (tests/compensation/benefits-utilization-fixtures.test.ts) and the C# Tims.Domain.Compensation.CompensationKernels.BuildBenefitsUtilization (Tims.UnitTests).
